headline: Department of Artificial Intelligence would regulate advanced artificial intelligence systems
text:
Here is how your fear of AI is being used to centralize power today.

Congress would give the Department of Artificial Intelligence the power to regulate advanced artificial intelligence systems. Not passed.

114 measures in 32 jurisdictions would create an AI office, or hand an existing one new authority over AI or data centers.

89 measures in 29 jurisdictions cite the fear that data centers are taking the power and the water.

2,216 measures tracked. 746 carry a control, and they would hand new power to 101 offices.
